units.source_text: 阿泷正蹲在厢房正门给监工裹黄色的绑腿带子。

en.t: Otaki was crouching at the front entrance of the side room, wrapping the supervisor's yellow gaiter straps around his legs.

units.source_text: 她那白皙的颈项和桃花瓣的发髻，依贴在坐在正门上的监工的膝上，

en.t: Her fair neck and peach-petal-like coiffure rested against the knees of the supervisor sitting at the entrance,

units.source_text: 好似一件被人遗忘的可怜的东西。

en.t: as if she were some poor thing that had been forgotten by everyone.
